title: A Causal Explainable Guardrails for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The BOLD benchmark was used to evaluate bias in generated responses by measuring the sentiment of text generated from prompts related to religion.
findings: The proposed method, LLMGuardrail, demonstrated superior performance on the BOLD benchmark, which measures bias across several domains including religion. It achieved a higher average sentiment score (indicating less negative bias) and a higher refusal rate for prompts that could lead to biased content compared to baseline models and other steering techniques.
